rules.rule:
Specialized directives for modules/agent_tools.py (Native Filesystem, Edit & Tool Execution Engine).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) 3-stage resilient string replacement (Exact -> Whitespace-Normalized -> 88% Fuzzy Match) in _resilient_replace(); (2) Lazy diff console initialization and Rich Syntax proxy wrappers; (3) In-memory session tracking (_SESSION_READ_FILES, _SESSION_MODIFIED_FILES) strictly guarded by _is_outside_workspace to prevent ../ path pollution; (4) Incremental line streaming, 8MB size guarding, and accurate total line draining in read_file(); (5) Atomic file writing via PID-tagged tempfiles cleaned up in finally blocks, with an immediate pre-replace os.stat check closing TOCTOU race windows; (6) Direct argv execution bypassing /bin/sh when SHELL_METACHARS are absent; (7) Polled non-blocking raw os.read() with codecs incremental decoder in run_command() preventing readline buffer deadlocks; (8) Nanosecond st_mtime_ns and st_size conflict detection in edit_file(); (9) Thread-safe sub-agent recursion guard using contextvars.ContextVar (_SUBAGENT_DEPTH); (10) Pre-gate placement evaluating security gates before any file existence or line-count probing; (11) allow_outside parameter coordination between _security_gate and _search_codebase; (12) Strict _coerce_bool preventing string 'false'/'no' overwrite escalation; (13) Preserving original file modes (stat.S_IMODE) and newline='' line endings in edit_file and write_file; (14) Refusing overwrite on unreadable existing files; (15) Canonical sys.modules cache invalidation checking __file__ equality to evict dotted package submodules; (16) Strict UTF-8 validation (errors='strict') on existing files in write_file() prior to overwrite.
HUNT FOR: (1) Process group cleanup & signal errors: verify that os.killpg() in run_command() catches ProcessLookupError, PermissionError, and OSError, followed by bounded proc.wait() and pipe FD closure on all timeout and exit paths; (2) TOCTOU mutation windows: verify file modifications re-verify stat metadata immediately before os.replace(); (3) Path containment & symlink symmetry: ensure direct file search roots cannot bypass symlink/containment checks enforced during directory walks; (4) Character set & encoding fidelity: ensure strict UTF-8 checking protects non-UTF-8 files from destructive silent overwrites; (5) Workspace session hygiene: verify session tracking sets never store out-of-workspace paths or relative traversal tokens.

Specialized directives for plugins/t3code/* (T3 Code ACP Bridge & Launcher).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Fail-closed make_confirm_gate() returning False on both branches (in non-interactive stdio mode, standard in-bounds edits are governed by AI_CONFIRM_GATES, while any call reaching confirm_gate() is either a supervised/plan mode block or a Zero-Trust boundary violation that must unconditionally return False; do NOT suggest returning is_yolo); (2) Line-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio transport and STDOUT_LOCK serialization; (3) Daemon worker threads in handle_acp_prompt() preventing stdio loop stalls; (4) Suppressing raw <tool_call and <function= tags from message chunks to avoid chat UI leakage; (5) Reading workspace configuration and YOLO flags from .agent/config.json; (6) Automated workspace handover via ~/.t3/bin/t3 app background subshell.
HUNT FOR: (1) Over-broad process termination (e.g. blanket pkill -f killing unrelated instances instead of tracked $T3_PID); (2) Untracked background handover subshells leaking on early script exit; (3) Orphaned tool_calls: ensure every assistant message declaring tool_calls is strictly paired with role: tool responses across all cancellation, denial, and exception paths; (4) Unhandled exceptions in handle_acp_prompt() failing to dispatch send_rpc_response(req_id); (5) Trap handlers on INT/TERM failing to explicitly terminate with 130/143.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_adapters.py (Self-healing parser for SLMs and quantized LLMs).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Independent multi-format extraction across Hermes, DSML, Mistral, Ling, XML, and JSON without early short-circuiting; (2) Full-fence-only markdown unwrapping in heal_json_args() to prevent truncating internal codeblocks; (3) Scoping XML tag stripping strictly to Pass 4 fallback to preserve legitimate code payloads; (4) Extracting only the first contiguous hunk in _extract_diff_hunk() for surgical edits; (5) Strict @@ -line,count +line,count @@ header validation; (6) Shell escape fidelity in _safe_shell_write() (differentiating single-quoted literals, printf specifiers, and echo -e); (7) Unterminated trailing codeblock recovery (\Z); (8) Linear brace scanning with failed-start skips; (9) Monotonic line-number gutter stripping in _strip_line_number_gutters(); (10) Linear heredoc parsing in _parse_heredoc(); (11) Safe serialization using json.dumps(..., default=str).
HUNT FOR: (1) Structural validation: verify that every extracted tool call strictly validates function name and argument mapping before dispatch; (2) Unbalanced nesting performance: verify that deeply malformed JSON braces or quotes cannot trigger quadratic scanning; (3) Shell parameter safety: ensure unquoted heredocs or shell commands containing unexpanded variables ($VAR) are never coerced into write_file.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_core.py (Core streaming agent loop & SSE engine).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Post-stream ANSI cursor rewinds clamped to physical viewport (raw_lines < rows - 1) with non-streamed terminal fallback; (2) Calculating fallback prompt tokens from body_messages (including ephemeral_directives); (3) Explicit ALLOWED_MODULES allowlist in run_mod(); (4) Structured return sentinel on max_rounds exhaustion; (5) Bounded 30-file scratchpad FIFO rotation; (6) Envelope-only unwrapping in _heal_tool_args (arguments/args/input/params); (7) Structural denial short-circuiting across string, list, and tuple tool outputs (is_denied); (8) Bounded connection/read timeout tuple (15, min(timeout, 30)); (9) Dedicated _finalize_speed_test() teardown across all exit paths; (10) Ephemeral directive overlays on body_tools['messages']; (11) Lazy runtime loading via _LazyConsole or dynamic Markdown wrappers; (12) In-function deferred imports of requests, agent_ipython, or agent_ui; (13) Thread-local HTTP session pooling (_local_session); (14) Atomic state persistence via PID-tagged tempfiles and os.replace; (15) sys.excepthook overriding with _clean_sigint_handler; (16) Monkeypatching Markdown.elements with CleanCodeBlock; (17) Centralized TerminalLayout sentinel transitions (layout.to, layout.gap, layout.reset, layout.record_newlines) and layout phase coordination (spinner, tool, answer, telemetry).
HUNT FOR: (1) Tool-call/result pairing integrity under exceptions: verify that every assistant tool_calls message is strictly paired with role: tool responses across all error and denial paths to prevent provider 400 errors; (2) Compaction & transcript slicing: verify that messages[:] = prune_history(...) inside the turn loop never slices between an assistant tool_calls message and its tool results; (3) Connection pool recycling & socket drops: ensure requests connection adapters properly recycle sockets back to the pool under remote resets, ChunkedEncodingError, or SIGINT; (4) Terminal stream geometry: verify that RichStreamer and cursor rewinds behave correctly under terminal dimensions and signal interruptions.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_stream.py (Streaming SSE, ANSI Geometry & Rich Streamer).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Slotted TerminalLayout sentinel (__slots__, layout.to, layout.gap, layout.reset, layout.record_newlines) enforcing deterministic vertical rhythm across visual blocks; (2) Width-aware sub-word buffering and gutter rail (│ ) emission in _stream_think_token; (3) Subclassing Markdown as AgentMarkdown; (4) Terminal cursor rewinds in get_cursor_up_count clamped to physical viewport; (5) Stream chunk parsing in _process_stream_chunk; (6) 10s TTL memoization on _get_code_theme; (7) Resetting layout on SIGINT and turn boundaries; (8) Deterministic single-blank-line vertical spacing between visual cards; (9) List chunk accumulators (_acc_think_parts, _acc_ans_parts) preventing quadratic string re-allocations; (10) Guarded .replace() containment checks on tool markers; (11) Preserving parts[0] pre-tag tokens in in_post_think; (12) Module-level TerminalLayout singleton (layout) and unsynchronized _get_code_theme cache writes on single-threaded CLI stream paths.
HUNT FOR: (1) Unhandled exceptions during token streaming; (2) Unclosed thinking blocks or dangling gutters on stream abort/error exits; (3) Terminal cursor state leaks (leaving cursor hidden \033[?25l) on abnormal termination or unhandled exceptions.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_security.py (Zero-Trust Security & Boundary Enforcement Kernel).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Strict AST inspection blocking bare open(), FileIO(), io.open(), codecs.open(), and builtins.open(); (2) Rejecting subscripted callable execution in AST; (3) Recursive inspection of nested interpreter -c payloads with depth cap (max 8 levels) and short-option cluster matching (-[a-zA-Z]*c); (4) Fixed-point iterative unwrapping of EXEC_WRAPPERS, WRAPPER_VALUE_FLAGS, and SHELL_RESERVED_WORDS; (5) Balanced substitution extraction (_extract_balanced_substitutions) supporting $(), <(), >(), and ``; (6) Fail-closed shlex error handling denying unbalanced quotes; (7) Dynamic import alias tracking for __import__ and importlib.import_module; (8) Dual TTY requirement in _is_interactive(); (9) Whitelisting canonical SYSTEM_DEVICES; (10) Read-only inspection subcommands for systemctl, pacman, journalctl; (11) Container sandbox healing (/workspace, /app) in resolve_path().
HUNT FOR: (1) Unhandled bypasses in AST reflection; (2) Path normalization bypasses via symlink chains; (3) Authorization gate fail-closed integrity in authorize().

Specialized directives for modules/agent_commands.py (Slash Command Dispatcher & Session Action Router).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Strict tuple and equality checks for commands preventing partial substring routing; (2) Shared apply_codespace_map() and remove_codespace_map() helpers managing map context safely; (3) Exact equality match for -load preventing accidental rollbacks; (4) Graceful pkill -TERM signal termination for audio processes; (5) Explicit 180s timeout handling for index-map subprocess in /sync.
HUNT FOR: (1) Substring routing collisions in command matching; (2) IndexError on empty chat_history; (3) Unhandled exceptions during file context loading; (4) Unbounded subprocess execution without timeout.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_context.py (Context Search, Indexing & 3-Zone Compaction Engine).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Jaccard semantic intent matching with precompiled word-boundary regexes; (2) Fast token heuristic (len * 10 // 36); (3) 3-Zone Context Compaction preserving system prompt, session anchors, and paired recent tail; (4) Context status meter using Rich panels and dynamic box styling; (5) Atomic cache key using st_mtime_ns, st_size, and frozen stop-words; (6) 30s TTL cache on upstream llama.cpp server /props queries; (7) 2MB size limit on blueprint context files.
HUNT FOR: (1) Unbounded file reads without size limits; (2) Intent matching false positives from unanchored substrings; (3) Slicing or orphaning tool responses from initiating assistant tool_calls in prune_history(); (4) Cache mutability leaks where callers corrupt shared tokens data.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_skills.py (Unified Skill Resolver & Interactive Selector).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Fail-closed security validation blocking tool execution if agent_security is unavailable; (2) Universal frontmatter parsing across YAML, JSON, and raw Markdown; (3) Sanitizing child environment variables (DANGEROUS_ENV_SUBSTRINGS) prior to subprocess execution; (4) Deep-copying message dictionaries in run_skill_selector() preventing caller history mutation; (5) Bounded 1MB file reading on skill files and 2MB cap on stdin history streams; (6) 15s timeout on ensure_mysys_exists() subprocess invocation.
HUNT FOR: (1) Path traversal vulnerabilities escaping base_skills_dir in find_skill_file(); (2) Command injection in unquoted shell execution paths; (3) Unhandled exceptions during frontmatter parsing; (4) Unbounded subprocess execution without timeout.

Specialized directives for tools/index-map/index-map (AST Knowledge Graph & Shorthand Indexer).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) should_ignore() filtering in compile_ascii_tree() preventing secret leakage; (2) Quoted FTS5 search terms (\"term\"*) with sqlite3.OperationalError fallback to LIKE; (3) Commonpath root verification in extract_snippet(); (4) Unified try/finally database connection cleanup covering filesystem walk; (5) PID-tagged atomic temporary files (.tmp.<pid>); (6) Case-sensitive gitignore pattern matching with lowercased DEFAULT_IGNORED; (7) Bounded readline(4096) chunk reading in get_file_summary().
HUNT FOR: (1) Unvalidated database filepaths escaping workspace root in snippet extraction; (2) FTS5 query syntax errors from unquoted operator keywords; (3) Leaking secret or credential files into flat index map text outputs; (4) SQLite connection leaks on unhandled walk exceptions.

Specialized directives for modules/model-select.py (Interactive TUI Model & Provider Configuration Engine).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Pre-write 0600 file descriptors (os.open with 0o600) for secrets in _atomic_write_env() and LAST_KEY_FILE; (2) Raw termios single-key reading and ANSI cursor manipulation; (3) Recognizing 'not-needed' as a valid active key for local server and Hugging Face space endpoints; (4) Bounded 5MB stream reads on remote model list queries; (5) try/finally terminal attribute and cursor cleanup in async_main(); (6) Dynamic CUSTOM<N> regex extraction and sanitization.
HUNT FOR: (1) Secrets written to temporary files prior to restrictive chmod permissions; (2) Unsanitized user inputs containing quotes or newlines injecting .env lines; (3) Terminal state and cursor leaks when exiting unexpectedly or via Ctrl+C; (4) Unbounded memory consumption on remote API response reads.

Specialized directives for ai-hook.sh (Dual-Shell Bash >=4.4 + Zsh >=5.0 interactive hook).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Dual-shell scripting in a single file; (2) eval "$exp" in ai_handle_missing (deliberate shortcut execution pre-validated via bash -n / zsh -n); (3) Terminal clear sequence printf '\x1b[H\x1b[2J'; (4) PID-tagged directory teleportation files .active_cd.$$; (5) Direct /proc/$pid/comm and kill -0 probes; (6) Pure shell IFS= read -r loops in _ai_teleport; (7) ws_path variable naming preserving Zsh special $path ($PATH); (8) Anchored ^(bash|zsh|sh)$ process checks in lockfile reaper; (9) Pre-lockfile trap installation covering HUP, INT, and TERM; (10) Delimiter-safe # ECMA-48 sed stripping in ai_handle_missing().
HUNT FOR: Sub-millisecond latency regressions (zero subshells $(...) or external forks in _ai_teleport common path); command-not-found recursion loops in _AI_CNF_ACTIVE; word splitting on unquoted $ws_path, $target, or $exp; cd calls missing -- terminator; and path pollution in CDPATH= cd -- "$ws_path" && pwd -P.

Specialized directives for plugins/zed/gpui-bridge.py (JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio bridge for Zed ACP).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Line-delimited JSON-RPC stdio transport; (2) Per-turn daemon worker threads in handle_session_prompt; (3) Synchronous 60s ACP permission waits on threading.Event(); (4) Advertising loadSession: False and rejecting session/load with -32602; (5) Single-component leading slash normalization (/calc.py -> calc.py); (6) Ephemeral memory injection into transient messages[-1] only; (7) Module-level requests.Session() pooling.
HUNT FOR: Unhandled exceptions dropping RPC error responses (-32601, -32602, -32603) and leaving Zed hanging; permission response parsing leaks in _pending_requests; race conditions in session['lock'] between session/cancel and worker threads; guaranteeing session['busy'] = False in finally blocks; socket leaks on ChunkedEncodingError; orphaned tool calls missing matching role: tool responses; and security gate distinction ensuring critical events (OUT-OF-BOUNDS, PYTHON DANGEROUS OP) always prompt the client.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_ui.py (Terminal UI, Spinners, and Raw Keypress Engine).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Low-level termios manipulation in _read_fd() using tty.setraw() and multi-packet escape byte buffering without tcflush (required for zero-latency navigation and preserving buffered input; do NOT suggest input()); (2) Raw ANSI cursor positioning escapes and batched _glimmer style grouping; (3) Data-driven 6-tuple STYLES matrix; (4) Precomputed static _WAVE_PATTERN in CalmBoatSpinner; (5) Safe string partition('|||') with fallback in run_interactive_selection().
HUNT FOR: Unconditionally guaranteed cursor restoration (\033[?25h) and termios attribute restoration (termios.tcsetattr) in finally blocks across all menus and spinners; and thread-safety races where background spinner writes to sys.stderr interleave with stdout output.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_ipython.py (Standalone IPython Kernel & Execution Sandbox).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Dynamic execution of Python code in-process; (2) Custom AST validation hooks; (3) Subclassing CellTimeoutError from BaseException preventing user except Exception from swallowing cell alarms; (4) Inspecting res.error_in_exec for CellTimeoutError in IPython execution path; (5) Restoring elapsed alarm budget in delegate(); (6) Separating compile() from eval()/exec() to prevent side-effect duplication on runtime SyntaxErrors; (7) Installing safe_open and safe_listdir into kernel user namespace.
HUNT FOR: Evasion of inspect_ast_safety via obfuscated reflection (__subclasses__, __class__, getattr); subprocess pipe buffer deadlocks in shell tool calls; and boundary escapes in safe_open() or safe_listdir() bypassing workspace realpath validation.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_sessions.py (SQLite Session, Checkpoints & Sub-Agent Worktrees).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) SQLite URI read-only connections (mode=ro); (2) Automated git worktree branching for sub-agents; (3) Anchored regex matching on session lockfiles preventing workspace-prefix collisions; (4) Refusing silent workspace fallback on worktree creation failure; (5) Preserving branch and worktree on git merge conflict; (6) Loop cancellation on empty key in rollback_checkpoint(); (7) Leak-proof /dev/tty descriptor cleanup in get_key(); (8) Eliminating duplicate indexes redundant to UNIQUE(workspace, tag).
HUNT FOR: (1) SQLite database locked errors (missing busy_timeout); (2) Unclosed connection handles during exceptions; (3) Stale session lockfile reaping race conditions; (4) Sub-agent branch leaks when cleanup is aborted.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_tui_async.py (Async Background Services & IPC Hub).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) uvloop event loop usage; (2) Unix domain sockets for sub-agent communication.
HUNT FOR: Orphaned Unix domain sockets in /tmp/*.sock failing to unlink on shutdown or unhandled exception; unhandled asyncio.CancelledError causing state corruption; and message framing errors in stream communication.

Specialized directives for tools/system/* (System Diagnostics & Host Inspection Utilities).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Direct inspection of /proc, /sys/class/hwmon, and /var/log; (2) Read-only execution of journalctl, systemctl list-units, ss -tulnpH, pacman -Qm, checkupdates, or df; (3) Semantic IP masking in security-audit (replacing private IPs with tokens like [localhost] or [private-ip] is an intentional privacy layer).
HUNT FOR: E2BIG command line argument overflows (large payloads like PKGBUILDs or diffs must use stdin or tempfiles, not argv); flawed script directory resolution using raw dirname "$0" instead of cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P; dynamic execution via source "$ENV_PATH" or source .env (must be parsed statically); bad indirect variable expansion ${!var} under set -u; and unquoted git commit -m "$msg" calls missing -- termination.

Specialized directives for plugin protocol bridges (DeepSeek Harness, PyCode, Zed).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Stdio streaming RPC protocols; (2) Deferred module imports.
HUNT FOR: Pipe buffer deadlocks when writing JSON chunks to stdout; unhandled socket disconnection errors; and missing role: tool response records when tool calls are aborted or declined.

Specialized directives for pykeep.py (High-Performance Textual KeePass TUI).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Lazy and deferred module imports (importing pykeepass inside unlock(); pyotp inside extract_totp(); secrets, string in generate_password(); shutil, datetime in create_db_backup())—these are intentional micro-optimizations keeping initial cold-start under 50ms; (2) Background clipboard auto-clearing via detached subprocess.Popen('sleep ... && wl-copy --clear', shell=True)—intentional fire-and-forget to avoid blocking the Textual async event loop; (3) Plaintext master password handling during unlock()—ephemeral in-memory string passed directly into PyKeePass constructor and discarded; (4) Slot-based search indexing using CachedItem(__slots__) and pre-lowercased search_blob strings—intentional optimization bypassing repeated string allocation and property lookups during keystroke filtering; (5) Textual DataTable bulk insertion using table.add_rows() instead of row-by-row iteration; (6) Direct property mutation on PyKeePass entry objects (entry.title, entry.username, entry.password, entry.url) followed by self.kp.save()—standard PyKeePass mutation API; (7) Dual-path TOTP extraction checking both entry.otp (URI) and custom_properties (TOTP Seed, TimeOtp-Secret, otp, TOTP); (8) Inline CSS string defined inside PyKeepApp.CSS; (9) Deferred interval timer (set_interval(1.0, self.tick_live_totp)) initialized only inside unlock() after authentication; (10) Non-sensitive theme state persistence in ~/.config/pykeep/.state.json.
HUNT FOR: (1) Database corruption & atomic save integrity: verify that self.kp.save() calls in add/edit/delete/backup operations are properly guarded and handle IOErrors, permission denials, or disk full conditions without leaving corrupt .kdbx files; (2) Memory & leak hygiene: verify master passwords or decrypted entry secrets are never written to disk logs, unhandled exception traces, or saved into .state.json; (3) Cache & view desynchronization: ensure every mutation (handle_entry_added, handle_entry_edited, handle_entry_deleted, handle_totp_saved) calls rebuild_cache() so cached_items and filtered_items remain strictly synchronized with self.kp.entries; (4) Cursor boundary & index errors: ensure get_current_entry() safely guards against IndexError when cursor_row is out of bounds or when filtered_items is empty; (5) TOTP secret formatting bugs: verify raw TOTP secrets are stripped of whitespace and normalized to uppercase prior to pyotp.TOTP() instantiation to prevent binascii base32 decoding crashes; (6) Subprocess safety: ensure xdg-open and wl-copy invocations handle missing binaries or non-Wayland environments gracefully.

Global Py-Agent Python Policy:
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Zero-daemon architecture (strict Python stdlib + SQLite + requests + rich; do NOT suggest Redis, Docker, Celery, or vector databases); (2) ANSI control escapes for formatting terminal output.
HUNT FOR: Cursor restoration (\033[?25h) missing in finally blocks; subprocess calls using shell=True without shlex.quote; unbounded file reads without size guards (preventing OOM); and unhandled SIGINT leading to unclean exits.

Global Py-Agent Shell Policy:
DO NOT FLAG: (1) POSIX shell scripts using portable idioms.
HUNT FOR: Unquoted variable expansions causing word splitting on paths with spaces; unhandled exit codes under set -e; background process leaks ($!) without EXIT traps; and unsafe sourcing of user-writable environment files.
